plugins.name: Web Testing — AI design assistant

plugins.author: B2IT

plugins.name: Web Testing — Selenium driver

plugins.author: B2IT

plugins.name: Git Diff Viewer
plugins.description: Working-directory diff viewer for a context's git_repo item: a changed-file tree with +/- counts, filtering, and a syntax-coloured hunk view. Reached via the arrow on a git_repo context item.
plugins.author: B2IT

plugins.name: Git Mining
plugins.description: Git repo mining engine on a generic unit-of-work model: server-managed repositories (remote URL + tracked branches the server clones itself), scheduled scanning, and pluggable processors. Mined data is generic WorkItems (git_commit, branch, and later pull_request / jira_issue) connected by relations, persisted behind an extension point (roadmap.gitmining.persistence — SQLite default / filesystem / satellites). Work items come from sources (roadmap.gitmining.sources — built-in git). Distinct from the local-development git repos owned by the context plugin.
plugins.author: B2IT

defines.detail: Persistence backends that store work items, relations, processor results, and source cursors (SQLite, filesystem, …).
Sources of work items — git commits + branches built-in; pull requests, Jira issues, … as satellites.
Processors that extract structured data from a work item (declaring which item types they handle).

implements.detail: Git Mining settings tab (persistence choice, credentials, processors).
gitmining.scan — periodic fetch + ingest of changed branches.

plugins.name: Jira / Confluence context items
plugins.description: Contributes the jira_issue / confluence_page context item types + previews + MCP tools, consuming the atlassian datasource service.
plugins.author: B2IT

plugins.name: Jobs
plugins.description: Generic async job registry: durable background jobs with status + an incremental log, a reusable run_async helper (daemon thread + workspace re-pin), and a /api/jobs monitor. Mined-data-style swappable persistence (roadmap.jobs.persistence) — built-in SQLite (default) and filesystem, satellites can add Postgres/SQL-Server. Used by any plugin that runs background work (e.g. git mining).
plugins.author: B2IT

defines.detail: Persistence backends that store background job records (SQLite, filesystem, …).

plugins.name: Knowledge Base
plugins.description: AI-backed Knowledge Base. Two layers: a ground-truth layer that ingests the organisation's information sources into one graph of nodes and links, and (later) a knowledge layer of persona-specific topics written and maintained by AI agents. This plugin is layer 1 plus the persona list the knowledge layer will write for. It replaces the earlier Company Brain plugin, which is being retired — nothing here depends on it.
plugins.author: B2IT

implements.detail: Knowledge Base settings group: Sources (which information sources feed the ground layer) and Personas (who the knowledge layer writes for).
kb_read / kb_write / kb_admin — three action-based tools grouped by role: query the graph, change it, and administer its node types.

plugins.name: Knowledge Base — flow runner
plugins.description: Runs Knowledge Base flows on the server: reads the flow's source, asks the configured AI provider, validates the answer against the node types and writes it into the graph with its provenance. Without it the Knowledge Base still has flows — it hands out briefs for an external AI to carry out; this plugin is what lets Roadmap do the thinking itself. Contributes the source-reader extension point and its three built-in readers, and a scheduled task that starts a flow when its source has moved.
plugins.author: B2IT

provides.detail: FlowReader — turns a flow's source into the material its prompt is built from. Built-ins: repo (a configured Git Repo's working tree), kb_source (nodes already in the graph), context (a Roadmap context).

implements.detail: knowledgebase.flows.scan — start the flows whose source has moved.

plugins.name: Mockups
plugins.description: Mock-UI designer: create projects and screens, edit each screen in a Balsamiq-style wireframe editor (drag/drop widget palette + property panel), and wire screens into click-through flows. Self-contained; stores JSON under <config_dir>/mockups/.
plugins.author: B2IT

plugins.name: Scheduler
plugins.description: Generic periodic-task scheduler: plugins contribute a run() callable to roadmap.scheduler.tasks and a central config (this plugin's) sets each task's cron + enabled. One workspace-aware background loop fires due tasks with the workspace pinned and only while the app is unlocked. Stops plugins reinventing their own schedulers.
plugins.author: B2IT

defines.detail: Periodic tasks (id + run callable) the scheduler fires on their configured cron.

implements.detail: Scheduler settings tab (the central per-task cron + enabled).

plugins.name: Workflows
plugins.description: Workflow automation engine: reusable step definitions (single-step templates, partially filled), composed into flows and invoked as live step-by-step invocations with a parameter context and an AI-blind credentials vault. Executor-agnostic (declares roadmap.workflow.executors); ships built-in http/shell/python/readdir executors plus a browser-free mock executor.
plugins.author: B2IT

defines.detail: Executors that perform one resolved step against a target (HTTP, shell, filesystem, browser, …).

implements.detail: workflow_invocation — pin a flow-invocation report into a context.

plugins.name: Workflows — ActiveMQ executor
plugins.description: ActiveMQ executor for the Roadmap workflow engine. Publishes a message via ActiveMQ Classic's REST API (POST /api/message) — destination + JMS properties as query params, Basic auth from the credentials vault (AI-blind), CSRF-cookie priming. No JMS/STOMP client needed. Contributes the `activemq` step kind, self-describing so it appears in the step editor with no engine change.
plugins.author: B2IT

plugins.name: Workflows — AI assistant
plugins.description: AI assistant for the workflow engine: a stateless flow composer that assembles a flow from existing step definitions (their ids/names/kinds/descriptions and which config fields are pre-filled vs blank). The AI never executes anything and never sees a credential; every reference it emits is validated against the stepdef catalog. Serves /api/workflow-assistant.
plugins.author: B2IT

plugins.name: Workflows — SQL Server executor
plugins.description: SQL Server executor for the Roadmap workflow engine. Runs a SQL query or statement via pymssql (no ODBC/JVM); accepts a jdbc:sqlserver:// URL and parses it, with login from the credentials vault (AI-blind). Contributes the `sql` step kind, self-describing so it appears in the step editor with no engine change.
plugins.author: B2IT
